Discussion ensued between the mayor and city council regarding waiving late fees associated to business license permits. 

JD noted he is in favor of staff recommendation #2. LDH noted she is in favor of waiving late fees for a specific time during the local emergency.  and Pro rate the businesses that have already paid their business License fee.
